name: text-outline-spotlight
title: Spotlight Outline Hover
description: Một chữ rất lớn chỉ có nét viền tự vẽ ra, rồi một đốm sáng theo con trỏ tô màu cầu vồng phát sáng lên phần nét viền nằm trong đốm.

moworks.author: moworks

options.dash: user units of the drawing dash (1300)
options.cross: s the pointer reaches the left edge, the right edge, and leaves ([2.0, 3.8, 4.3])

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Aceternity UI: written from the idea only

moworks.notes: Word 78 px, outline only (1.1 px, mute), drawn on with a 260 px dash, offset 260 → 0, 0.2–2.4 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) (recipe 1000 → 0 in 4 s). Spot: same outline at 2.2 px with a diagonal yellow → accent → blue gradient and a 14 px accent glow, seen through a radial mask r 62 px (≈19 % of width; 1 → 0.8 at 55 % → 0) on a scripted cursor (enters 2.0 s, crosses to 3.8 s, exits 4.3 s); spot in 1.6–2.0 s, out 3.9–4.3 s. Fade 4.45–4.9 s. Loop 5 s. Params: thời gian vẽ (2.2 s) · bán kính đốm (62 px) · nét viền (1.1 / 2.2 px). Apply to an SVG text drawn as an outline (fill none). A glowing gradient copy of the outline shows only inside a soft round mask that follows the pointer.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ viền nét sáng màu theo con trỏ
